title: One-Tray Creamy BBQ Chicken Pasta
description: Dry pasta, diced chicken, capsicum and onion baked in a creamy BBQ tomato sauce under mozzarella. One dish, no pre-boiling.

source.name: Firsttakehadrian (Instagram)
source.note: Hype or Hoax, Episode 251, rated 8.5/10 (Worth the Hype). Original inspiration: @davefellfitness.

confidence.note: Amounts and method from the creator's caption. Not yet cooked.

nutrition.note: As stated by the creator; fibre marked as his estimate.

items.note: Dry weight, cooks in the dish
Used to rinse out the tomato tin

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add everything except the mozzarella to a large ovenproof dish: pasta ({{pasta}}), chicken ({{chicken}}), onion ({{onion}}), capsicum ({{capsicum}}), cream cheese ({{cream-cheese}}), BBQ seasoning ({{seasoning}}), tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), BBQ sauce ({{bbq-sauce}}), garlic ({{garlic}}), salt and pepper. Rinse the tomato tin with the water ({{water}}), add it, and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.text: Top with the mozzarella ({{mozzarella}}), cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Bake uncovered
steps.text: Uncover and bake for a final 5 minutes.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Rest for 5–10 minutes so the remaining liquid is absorbed.

notes.title: Seasoning
notes.text: BBQ seasoning and sauce both carry salt, so taste before adding more.
